name: Hat bang
summary: The kernel of trái bàng, roasted with salt or candied, and sold as a gift pack at the daily market. Prisoners gathered the leaves and the fruit when they were kept without greens. Peak-season supply is bought in, so not every bag is fruit picked on the island. No stall price was printed.
origin: Côn Đảo. The kernel of trái bàng, roasted with salt or candied.
history: The 11 July 2025 Đồng Nai report says prisoners gathered the leaves and the fruit when they were kept without greens. The island now roasts the kernels with salt or makes candied kernels.
culture: It is the souvenir the report says visitors buy. Traders pack it at chợ Côn Đảo. Peak-season supply is bought in from the eastern and western provinces, so not every bag is fruit picked on the island.
howToEat: Take it as a gift pack from the daily market. It is not a sit-down dish on the report.
The same report names the roasted kernels and the candied kernels. No stall price was printed.
where: Chợ Côn Đảo, the daily market in town. A stall name in the report is not a pick.
seoTitle: Hat bang — candied kernels from Con Dao
seoDescription: Hạt bàng is roasted with salt or candied and packed at the daily market on Côn Đảo. Peak-season fruit is also bought in. The price is check on arrival.
